non_blocking.description: Clean editable install initially failed because setuptools discovered non-package top-level directories in the flat layout.
non_blocking.resolution: Added explicit package discovery for Engine*, Tools*, and experiments* in pyproject.toml.

non_blocking.description: model_type=copy is not implemented for incremental synthetic generation in execution_mode=batches.
non_blocking.workaround: Use execution_mode=normal for copy smoke tests, or use synthetic_control in batches.

non_blocking.description: Legacy CSV CLI rejects a column name for --data_load_label_column and accepts an integer index such as -1.

When passing raw AppClassNet top200 paths directly to main.py, --num_classes must match the raw domain before subset filtering. The wrapper materializes subset paths and passes the reduced domain safely.
Some audit helpers also write latest-run copies under results/appclassnet_top200/* while output-specific copies are preserved under each run directory.
